assembly.title: Chassis Base Preparation and Main Bearing Installation
assembly.description: Inspect the 3D-printed or machined base pedestal. Press the 6806 deep-groove ball bearing (30mm ID x 42mm OD x 7mm W) square into the central machined bearing seat using an arbor press or gentle clamp.

assembly.title: Azimuth NEMA 17 Stepper & Pulley Installation
assembly.description: Mount the azimuth NEMA 17 stepper motor (M1) into the motor pocket using four M3x8mm screws with blue threadlocker. Slide a 20T GT2 aluminum pulley onto the motor shaft and tighten the two M3 grub screws against the shaft flat.

assembly.title: Rotary Turntable Ring & GT2 Timing Belt Tensioning
assembly.description: Install the central shaft through the 6806 bearing and seat the 60T GT2 driven pulley. Loop the GT2 closed-loop timing belt over the 20T and 60T pulleys, tension the belt to ~45 Hz deflection resonance, and lock the motor mount screws.

assembly.title: Elevation Yoke Arm & Tilt Pivot Assembly
assembly.description: Fasten the dual elevation upright arms to the rotary turntable ring. Press two 608ZZ bearings into the elevation yoke pivots. Mount the elevation NEMA 17 stepper motor (M2) to the drive side upright and fasten the tilt payload cradle.

assembly.title: Mechanical Limit Switch Installation & Physical Calibration
assembly.description: Secure the azimuth microswitch (SW1) and elevation microswitch (SW2) with M2.5 screws into their slotted alignment brackets. Adjust the switch trip levers so the actuator tabs engage 1.5mm before hard physical endstop contact.

assembly.title: Power Stage & Stepper Driver Carrier Assembly
assembly.description: Mount the MP1584 buck converter (VR1), DC power jack (J1), and TMC2209 stepper driver carrier boards (U2, U3) into the base electronics enclosure. Solder decoupling capacitors C1 and C2 directly across each driver's VMOT and GND pins.
assembly.danger_message: Ensure decoupling capacitors C1 and C2 are oriented with correct polarity. Reverse polarity will cause capacitor venting and driver failure.

assembly.title: ESP32 Controller & OLED Display Wire Harnessing
assembly.description: Connect the STEP, DIR, and EN control lines from ESP32 (U1) to drivers U2 and U3. Wire the limit switch NO signals to GPIO32 and GPIO33 with 10k pull-ups (R1, R2). Wire the SSD1306 OLED display (DISP1) to the 3.3V rail and I2C lines (GPIO21/GPIO22) with 4.7k pull-ups (R3, R4).

assembly.title: Pre-Power Validation & Trajectory Commissioning
assembly.description: Before connecting 12V mains, verify zero resistance between all ground points and check that the 5V and 3.3V power rails are isolated from 12V. Power on the 12V supply, verify the OLED boots with status telemetry, and run the automated homing routine.
assembly.danger_message: Do not disconnect stepper motor wiring while powered. Disconnecting motor coils under current causes inductive flyback voltage spikes that destroy the TMC2209 driver outputs.

assembly.title: 3D Print Housing and Diffuser Bar
assembly.description: 3D print the main angled enclosure and integrated base stand using opaque black or dark gray PETG/PLA (0.2mm layer height, 20% gyroid infill). Print the optical diffuser bar using translucent/clear PETG with 100% rectilinear infill to optimize optical dispersion.

assembly.title: Assemble Power Conditioning & Interface Board
assembly.description: Solder C1 (1000uF electrolytic capacitor) directly across the 5V and GND terminals of the DC barrel jack J1, observing negative stripe polarity. Solder C2 (100nF) across U2 VCC and GND pins. Wire U2 pin 1OE to GND.
assembly.danger_message: Reverse polarity installation of electrolytic capacitor C1 can result in capacitor rupture or venting upon power-up.

assembly.title: Wire ESP32 DevKitC and Level Shifter
assembly.description: Connect ESP32 GPIO4 to U2 pin 1A. Solder 330 Ohm damping resistor R1 between U2 pin 1Y and the WS2812B DIN lead. Connect ESP32 5V and GND pins to the 5V power bus.

assembly.title: Wire Front UI Buttons
assembly.description: Mount SW1 (Power), SW2 (Mode), and SW3 (Brightness) into the front-facing switch recesses. Connect one terminal of each switch to common GND, and wire the opposing terminals to ESP32 pins GPIO16, GPIO17, and GPIO18 respectively.

assembly.title: Install LED Strip into Enclosure Channel
assembly.description: Peel the adhesive backing from the 30-LED WS2812B strip. Carefully align and adhere the strip into the linear channel of the 3D-printed body. Solder the 5V, GND, and DIN wires from the harness to the strip pads.

assembly.title: Snap Diffuser Bar and Perform Bench Test
assembly.description: Plug in a certified 5V 3A DC power adapter to J1. Verify the ESP32 boots and LEDs illuminate. assembly.title: Base Pedestal & Power Ingress Assembly
assembly.description: Mount the 2.1mm DC barrel jack (J1) and LM2596 buck converter module (REG1) into the base pedestal enclosure using M3 standoffs. Wire J1 POS and NEG to REG1 IN+ and IN-. Install the 1000uF electrolytic capacitor (C1) across the 5V buck output terminals observing polarity.

assembly.title: Base Turntable and Yaw Actuator Installation
assembly.description: Press-fit the 608ZZ radial bearing (BRG1) into the base central journal. Install the MG996R servo (M1) vertically inside the base bracket and secure the 25T aluminum servo horn (HW1) onto the rotating turntable platter.

assembly.title: Shoulder Joint Dual-Clevis Assembly
assembly.description: Mount the shoulder MG996R servo (M2) into the rotating turret upright. Align the secondary 608ZZ radial bearing (BRG2) on the opposing clevis arm to ensure dual-shear support. Fasten the bicep link with aluminum horn (HW2).

assembly.title: Elbow and Forearm Linkage Assembly
assembly.description: Install the elbow MG996R servo (M3) at the apex of the bicep link and attach the forearm boom via the third 25T aluminum horn (HW3). Route the 3-pin servo extension leads along the interior cable channels.

assembly.title: Wrist Pitch, Roll and Parallel Gripper Assembly
assembly.description: Secure the MG90S micro servos for wrist pitch (M4) and wrist roll (M5) into the distal gimbal yoke. Mount the final MG90S servo (M6) into the parallel gripper chassis, meshing the pinion gear with both rack claw slides.

assembly.title: Electronics Interconnect & Initial Calibration
assembly.description: Mount the ESP32 (U1) and PCA9685 driver (U2) in the base cavity. Wire I2C SDA (GPIO21) and SCL (GPIO22). Connect all 6 servo 3-pin headers to PCA9685 channels 0 through 5. Connect 5V buck output to PCA9685 V+ and ESP32 VIN. Perform zero-angle calibration before attaching mechanical linkages.
assembly.danger_message: Verify buck regulator output is adjusted to 5.0V with a multimeter before plugging in servos to prevent overvoltage damage. Keep hands clear during initial power-on calibration.
